featured_reviews.name: Kartik Pujary
featured_reviews.review_text:
5 stars - Delicious Indo-Chinese Feast at Hot & Spice!
I recently dined at Hot & Spice Chinese Restaurant in Nalasopara West, opposite HDFC Bank, and it was a fantastic experience. The place has a welcoming vibe with clean tables and a casual setup perfect for family meals.
We ordered Veg Manchow Soup, Paneer Pepper Garlic Dry, Veg Hakka Noodles, and Soft Drink – everything arrived hot and flavorful. The Manchow Soup was spicy and packed with veggies, while the Paneer dish had tender pieces coated in a garlicky, peppery sauce that hit all the right notes.  The Hakka Noodles were stir-fried perfectly with crisp greens, and portions were generous for the price.
The bill came to just ₹1446 including GST for four items, super value for money in Mumbai suburbs.  Service was prompt, and the food photos match the vibrant menu promising Chinese delights.  Almost polished off everything – highly recommend for authentic spicy Chinese in Nalasopara! Will return soon.

featured_reviews.name: Sara Tambe
featured_reviews.review_text:
Unethical & Disrespectful Service

We had a horrible experience at this hotel. We were made to wait at the reception for over 45 minutes for check-in despite reaching on time. The worst part: we saw multiple customers who arrived after us being given rooms immediately just because they gave extra money (tip) to one of their staff member.

So basically, if you don’t bribe them, you wait. This is blatant favoritism and extremely unprofessional. We felt insulted and cheated.

Management needs to fix this corrupt practice. Until then, I cannot recommend this hotel to anyone who values fair treatment and basic respect.

featured_reviews.name: Ojas
featured_reviews.review_text: If you visit Hot & Spice Chinese Restaurant, you HAVE to try their chicken soup. It is easily the best I’ve had—perfectly seasoned, served piping hot, and full of flavor. It’s the ultimate comfort food. The rest of the menu is great too, but the soup is the real star here!

The attendant who answered my call said I cannot deliver the food to your place which is in nallasopara west at samelpada.

Worst experience ever. Though the guys are from my hometown mangaluru but I am really ashamed to call these people from my hometown.

Cherry on the cake they had already delivered to my location not even a week back. When asked the reason the person who attended my call just denied saying cannot deliver without any reasoning and asked me to pick it up.

featured_reviews.name: Faisal Makandar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Hot & Spice and had a mixed experience. The Chinese food here is genuinely very good—great taste, decent portions, and good quality ingredients. Definitely a place you can visit if you’re craving flavorful Chinese dishes.

However, the service is quite disappointing. The staff, especially the elderly person at the counter, comes across as rude and unwelcoming. Their behavior can make the overall experience unpleasant.

In short, visit this place for the food, but be prepared to ignore the arrogance and lack of hospitality.

featured_reviews.name: Vivek Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is one of best places to have Chinese food, they have their own unique menu and the food quality is just up to the mark.

I have been a regular at this place. Been coming here since its opened and have been loving the quality of food and service ever since.

Staff is good and the ambiance is also pleasing, cleaning and hygienic practices are noteworthy.

Food looks great by appearance and tastes awesome.. and the price is also reasonable.

I have recommended it to all my friends and acquaintances and would happily do the same for whoever reads this review.

featured_reviews.name: Muzammil Jiva
featured_reviews.review_text:
Subject: Complaint Regarding Poor Food Quality, Inadequate Quantity, and Unsatisfactory Service

I wish to formally raise a complaint regarding my recent order from Hot & Spice Restaurant, Nalasopara West (Patankar Park, opposite HDFC Bank).

I placed an order for 5 Chinese dishes amounting to ₹1,491 including GST:

• Chicken Dragon Rice – ₹290
• Chicken Pot Rice – ₹280
• Hot & Spice Special Fried Rice – ₹290
• Chicken Burnt Garlic Chilly Rice – ₹280
• Prawns Fried Rice – ₹280

I waited approximately 90 minutes outside the restaurant to collect the order. However, the food delivered was significantly below expected standards.

Despite ordering multiple chicken dishes, each gravy box contained only one very small chicken piece, while most rice dishes had no chicken at all. The quantity provided was extremely inadequate compared to the prices charged.

The food quality, portion size, and presentation did not match the expected standard associated with the dishes ordered. This caused inconvenience, disappointment, and embarrassment as the order had been arranged for guests.

Considering the amount charged and the waiting time involved, the service and product delivered were highly unsatisfactory. I request appropriate attention to food quality, quantity, and customer service standards to prevent similar experiences for other customers.

featured_reviews.review_text: Tried MK Chinese and honestly loved the taste. The noodles were perfectly cooked, Manchurian was flavorful, and the sauces were well balanced. Food is fresh, hygienic, and pocket-friendly. A must-try spot if you enjoy street-style Chinese food. 😋🔥

featured_reviews.review_text:
Ordered Apple Chicken from MK Chinese, Nallasopara West. I was told it would be a thick gravy, and I specifically asked them to make it sweet.

Instead, I received very spicy chicken lollipops with actual apple pieces added. This was not expected and made no sense taste-wise.

featured_reviews.name: Ishayu Sonawane
featured_reviews.review_text: The food was amazing. We tried paneer satey, veg crispy and triple sechwan fried rice. All of them were really good and tasty. There was very less food colour used in these dishes. The dish that I liked the most was paneer satey. This is the first Chinese place that I visited where this dish is served in smooth Indian gravy. All other do it in a chinese gravy which has hell lot of food coloring and garlic in it. The ambience of this place is pretty good. The service is also good. Hygiene is top notch. I love visiting this place when I crave chinese food. Overall a 9 on 10.

featured_reviews.name: Sachin Kamble
featured_reviews.review_text: We went for dinner and ordered the  chichen lollypop and Veg manchow soup. The soup was wattery, the chicken was burned from outside and bland. There was no taste whatsoever. We did not order the main course and went to a different restaurant . The service was slow. There was only 1 server who was looking after all the customers hence the delays in spite of it being a Sunday. Overall I would not recommend going by my experience. We went there after seeing the reviews but we were disappointed.

featured_reviews.name: Joycee Wood
featured_reviews.review_text:
We tried Chinese food from a Chinese shop for the first time, and the experience was truly best to best. The most impressive thing about this place is that it is extremely hygienic. The shop was very clean and well-maintained, from the kitchen area to the serving counter. The staff followed proper hygiene practices, which made us feel safe and comfortable.

Coming to the food, everything tasted absolutely delicious. The dishes were freshly prepared with perfectly balanced flavors—not too spicy and not bland at all. The noodles and fried rice were well cooked, light, and not oily. The presentation was neat, and the service was quick and polite.

Overall, this Chinese shop offers a perfect combination of great taste, quality food, fast service, and most hygienic environment. Our first experience was excellent, and we will definitely visit again. Highly recommended for anyone who loves tasty and hygienic Chinese food. 🍜✨

10/10 to Team Hot & Spice !!

featured_reviews.name: Dhwani Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
We ordered Chicken Manchow Soup and Chicken Triple Rice (parcel). The total bill came to ₹400.The Manchow soup quantity was very less, even though we ordered a full portion. It felt like they didn’t have a larger container and hence served it in a very small one. The consistency was quite thick, more like a gravy than a soup. Taste-wise, it was more tangy, almost like a hot and sour soup. However, the chicken quantity was generous, so no complaints there.
The Chicken Triple Rice was not good at all. The gravy served with it was tasteless and oddly sweet. Even the Schezwan chutney was sweet, which was disappointing. The rice itself was just okay. They claim they don’t use food colour or ajinomoto, which does seem true as both the rice and gravy were light in colour, this is a positive point. However, the taste didn’t meet expectations.
The quantity of rice was good, and both the soup and gravy were packed in the same-sized containers. Packaging was neat and intact, with no spillage.
Overall, it’s an okayish, but I wouldn’t recommend it based on taste.

featured_reviews.review_text: “Healthy and yummy Chinese food! Great portion sizes, bold flavours, and they make an effort to avoid additives like Ajinomoto and palm oil. Highly recommended.”

featured_reviews.name: Sarvesh Rawate
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst Chinese Food Experience – Total Waste of Money

I went to this place after watching their Instagram reels and honestly, it was a huge mistake. The food was absolutely terrible and I felt completely cheated after spending ₹250 here.

Cons:
1) Highly overpriced: Charging ₹110 for half egg noodles and ₹140 for half chicken lollipop is too expensive compared to other restaurants in Nalasopara, especially considering it's pathetic quality and quantity.
2) Zero authenticity: The so-called “Chinese” food tasted like cheap instant masala (Ching’s style). No flavour, no balance, no authenticity.
3) Extremely poor quality: The chicken lollipop was nothing but thick flour coating on a stick with barely any chicken inside. Felt like I was eating fried batter, not food.
4) Instagram hype only: The food quality is nowhere close to what they show on Instagram.

Honestly, this is one of the worst food experiences I’ve had in Nalasopara. I would strongly advise everyone to stay away and not fall into their Instagram trap. There are far better and cheaper options available nearby.

featured_reviews.name: Mustafa Dhukka
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Pinch of Salt is one of the best cloud kitchens in Nalasopara, delivering consistently delicious and freshly prepared food right to your doorstep. Even though it’s delivery-only, the quality and presentation of the dishes feel like a fine dining experience at home.

The menu is thoughtfully curated, offering a wide range of Indian, Chinese, and Continental options. I tried their butter chicken with garlic naan – absolutely mouthwatering, with perfect spice balance and tender chicken. The fried rice and chilli chicken combo was equally impressive, packed with flavor and aroma.

One thing I love is their attention to packaging – food always arrives hot, fresh, and spill-free. The containers are sturdy and eco-friendly, which shows their care for both customers and the environment.

Their biryani deserves a special mention – fragrant, flavorful, and portioned generously. For snacks, their cheesy fries and chicken popcorn are addictive and perfect for quick cravings.

Despite being a cloud kitchen, the taste is as good (if not better) than many dine-in restaurants. The team clearly focuses on hygiene, quality ingredients, and maintaining high standards.

Delivery is always on time, and the food reaches in perfect condition. Prices are reasonable for the quality and portion size you get.

Whether it’s a quick weekday lunch, a cozy dinner at home, or a special family treat, A Pinch of Salt is my go-to cloud kitchen in Nalasopara.

Highly recommended for anyone who wants restaurant-quality food in the comfort of their home!

featured_reviews.name: Dhwani Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
The restaurant was clean, well maintained, and properly air-conditioned. They also have a small TV and ample seating with enough tables.
They served fried noodles and Schezwan chutney as a side. We ordered Chicken Manchow Soup and Chicken Chopper Rice. The portion size was good. The soup was served piping hot, and the taste was well balanced and flavorful.
The chopper rice was okayish for me. Personally, I prefer chopper rice with thick gravy. Usually the gravy is richer, but this one had less gravy with mainly chicken pieces and beaten eggs, which made it a little dry to pair with the rice. However, the taste of the rice itself was good.
Overall, it’s a good place to try Chinese food.

featured_reviews.name: Arjun Rampal Escovar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Kimling Chinese Restaurant recently and had a really good experience.
The food quality is impressive, especially if you’re craving Indo-Chinese flavors. The taste is consistent, well-balanced, and not overly oily like many places. The quantity is generous, making it perfect for sharing with friends or family.
What stands out the most is that it’s very reasonably priced, so you get great value for money without compromising on taste or portion size. The menu has a good variety of options—from classic noodles and fried rice to starters and gravies.
The place itself is simple and comfortable, ideal for a casual dine-out or takeaway. Service is fairly quick, and the staff is polite.
Overall, a great spot in Nalasopara/Vasai East for satisfying your Chinese food cravings without burning a hole in your pocket. Definitely worth visiting again!
